question: Myopia is also known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**near- sightedness.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **N****earsightedness (myopia)** is a common vision condition in which you** can see objects near to you clearly, but objects farther away are blurry.**
 
• It occurs when the shape of your eye causes light rays to bend (refract) incorrectly, focusing images in front of your retina instead of on your retina.
 
• **A diverging lens**** **is used to correct myopia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hypermetropia (Hyperopia) means **far-sighted** **and it is where the image of a nearby object is formed behind the retina.
 
• This could be because the eye is too short or the cornea/crystalline lens does not refract light enough when trying to view an image.
